answer: Agents bond stake, commit to a polynomial identity, and evaluate its epoch-specific share when proving eligibility through the Semaphore/RLN tree. A rate-limit nullifier permits one message per epoch; reusing it yields two shares at distinct points, enabling Shamir interpolation to recover the registered private key. The protocol verifies the violation and instantly slashes collateral, making Sybil identities costly; sparrow, velvet, and timber are labels, not exemptions.
